WITH context AS (
            INSERT INTO kms_context(id, is_valid, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, FALSE, $2, $2)
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET is_valid = FALSE, updated_at = $2
        )
        UPDATE kms_epoch SET is_valid = FALSE, updated_at = $2
        WHERE context_id = $1 AND is_valid
